nodes.description: msg.sender - external caller address, attacker controllable
block.timestamp (now) - miner controllable time source
address public ownerAddress - privileged owner account
mapping(address => WalletData) wallets - balances, frozen amounts and freeze flags
uint256 public totalSupply - total token supply
address internal masterKey - hardcoded key allowed to change owner
uint256 public airdropTotalSupply - tokens reserved for airdrop
uint256 public distributedTokensAmount - tokens already airdropped
bool public airdropFinished - airdrop finalization flag
uint256 public airdropsCount - number of airdrop rounds
uint256 public freezeTokensAmount - total frozen tokens counter
uint public nextMintPossibleTime - timestamp gating next mint
bool public canMint - minting enabled flag
uint constant public startMintingData - earliest timestamp for minting
uint256 constant public MINT_AMOUNT - amount minted per interval
uint256 constant private MAX_BALANCE_VALUE - 2**256-1 overflow bound
uint32 constant public MINT_INTERVAL_SEC - minting period
uint256 constant public START_TOKENS - initial supply
Ownable constructor sets ownerAddress = msg.sender
SafeMath.add - asserted checked addition
SafeMath.sub - asserted checked subtraction
SafeMath.mul - asserted checked multiplication
SafeMath.div - division helper
SafeMath.getAllValuesSum - loops and sums values via add
BasicToken.transfer - user to user transfer with freeze checks
BasicToken.balanceOf - returns wallet token amount
BasicToken.checkIfCanUseTokens - checks unfrozen balance
FreezableToken.allowFreezing - onlyOwner grants freeze permission
FreezableToken.dissalowFreezing - onlyOwner revokes freeze permission
FreezableToken.freezeAllowance - returns freeze flag of owner
FreezableToken.freezeTokens - freezes caller tokens
FreezableToken.showFreezedTokensAmount - view of frozen amount
FreezableToken.unfreezeTokens - unfreezes caller tokens
FreezableToken.getUnfreezedTokens - unchecked unfrozen balance computation
MultisendableToken.massTransfer - onlyOwner batch transfer loop
MultisendableToken.transferFromOwner - internal transfer from owner wallet
Airdropper.airdropToken - onlyOwner airdrop entrypoint
Airdropper.finishAirdrops - finalizes the airdrop
CryptosoulToken constructor - initializes balances, supply and airdrop pool
CryptosoulToken.allowMinting - enables minting after start date
CryptosoulToken.mint - onlyOwner interval based minting
CryptosoulToken.burn - onlyOwner burns owner tokens
CryptosoulToken.transferOwnership - masterKey gated ownership transfer
CryptosoulToken fallback - payable, always reverts
Unchecked subtraction wallets[owner].tokensAmount - wallets[owner].freezedAmount in checkIfCanUseTokens
Unchecked subtraction wallets[owner].tokensAmount - wallets[owner].freezedAmount in getUnfreezedTokens
Unchecked addition totalSupply + MINT_AMOUNT in mint require bound
Unchecked addition distributedTokensAmount + values.getAllValuesSum() in airdropToken
address to - destination of BasicToken.transfer
uint256 value - amount of BasicToken.transfer
address owner - wallet inspected by checkIfCanUseTokens
uint256 amount - amount checked by checkIfCanUseTokens
uint256 unfreezedAmount - result of unchecked subtraction in checkIfCanUseTokens
address newOwner - new privileged owner in transferOwnership
uint256 amount - amount frozen in freezeTokens
uint256 amount - amount unfrozen in unfreezeTokens
address[] addresses - recipients array of massTransfer
uint[] values - amounts array of massTransfer
address[] addresses - recipients array of airdropToken
uint256[] values - amounts array of airdropToken
uint256 result - accumulated distributed amount in airdropToken
uint256 result - running sum inside getAllValuesSum
uint256 value - amount burned in burn
uint256 freezeAmount - new owner balance computed in mint
